Use skill caveman:caveman-review.

PR: Refactor
Branch: refactor/x -> main
Author: alice

CI checks:
- failed: (none)
- pending: (none)

Diff:
diff --git a/x b/x

Only include comments at severity "blocker" or "major".
Do NOT include nit, minor, style, or formatting suggestions.

Each "body" must be plain prose. Do NOT prefix it with severity tags
like "[blocker]" or "**MAJOR**:", emoji or icons (🔴 ⚠️ ✗ etc.), or
line markers like "L28:". The severity goes in the "severity" field
and the line goes in the "line" field — keep them out of the body.

Return ONLY JSON matching this schema (no prose before or after):
{
  "summary": "string (overall review summary, 2-5 sentences)",
  "comments": [
    {
      "path": "file path from diff",
      "line": <int, line number in NEW file>,
      "side": "RIGHT" | "LEFT",
      "body": "review comment",
      "severity": "blocker" | "major"
    }
  ]
}
